evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies `Chainstate::FlushStateToDisk()` in `src/validation.cpp` to correctly handle block-file flush failures.
rationale: Failing to abort on block-file flush errors permits coins database records and flush markers to advance beyond data durably written to disk. As noted in the problem description, `FlushStateToDisk()` previously logged a warning and continued executing, which mzumsande pointed out can lead to permanent corruption if `-blocksdir` fsync fails.
